name: model_l_reasoning_curriculum
_comment: MODEL L (Assamese) reasoning finetune, run 5: curriculum. Consumed by common/finetune.py via FinetuneConfig.from_json. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation.
_run5: Run 5. Settings borrowed from a classmate's Nepali finetune that
reported higher accuracy, applied to this project's data and measured
the same way as runs 1-4 -- reasoning accuracy AND test perplexity.
learning rate  1e-4 -> 2e-5, with 20% warmup instead of 10%
length         750 steps -> 6,000 (12 epochs of 8,000 at batch 16)
sampling       uniform -> curriculum, numeric tasks weighted 3:1 at
the start and chain tasks 3:1 at the end
The curriculum follows this project's own error analysis rather than
the classmate's template names: the numeric tasks are the ones these
models learn first, and the chain tasks compose exactly that skill.
weight_decay is 0.03, also from that config.
Many small updates instead of few large ones is the same lever that
kept run 4 from destroying the language model, taken further, so the
perplexity check matters here as much as the accuracy.
